messages.content: Who is currently the top ranked tennis player?

function.name: sports_team_standing
function.description: Retrieve the current standing/ranking of a sports team in its respective league. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

team_name.description: The name of the sports team.

league.description: The league in which the team participates.

season_year.description: The season year for which the standing is needed. If not provided, current year is assumed. Default: 1994

message.content:
I don’t have live access to the ATP/WTA ranking feeds, so I can’t tell you the exact name that’s at the top right now.  
The rankings are updated every Monday, so the “world No. 1” can change week‑to‑week.  

**Where to find the current top players**

| Governing body | Ranking page |
|----------------|--------------|
| ATP (men’s) | <https://www.atptour.com/en/rankings/singles> |
| WTA (women’s) | <https://www.wtatennis.com/rankings/singles> |

Just open the link and you’ll see the current #1 player (and the full list of the top 10). If you’re looking for a quick snapshot, the ATP page usually shows the top player’s name, country, and points, and the same goes for the WTA page.
